title: Deductible Reimbursement Added to the Replacement Credit
content:
## Deductible reimbursement added to the replacement credit — Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda claims rider

The replacement vehicle credit includes a reimbursement where the primary insurer withheld a deductible above the waiver tier's covered-deductible cap. The loss type and the insurer's deductible are read from the waiver's most recent GAP balance claim line, paid or denied.

**Covered-deductible cap by tier:** Kessler GAP Waiver 125 0.00; Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 500.00; Kessler GAP Waiver 150 500.00; Kessler GAP Plus 150 1,000.00; Kessler GAP Plus 175 1,000.00; Kessler GAP Commercial 130 0.00.

| Loss type on the claim line | Insurer's deductible | Reimbursement added |
|---|---|---|
| Total-loss collision | Above the tier's cap | 250.00 |
| Any other loss type (total-loss theft, other total loss) | Above the tier's cap | 150.00 |
| Any loss type | Not above the tier's cap | None |

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical, a tier cap of 1,000.00).** A deductible of exactly 1,000.00 is not above the cap: no reimbursement. A deductible of 1,000.01 on a collision loss: 250.00; on a theft loss: 150.00.

**Basis question.** *Which claim line is read where a waiver carries both a denied and a paid GAP balance line?* The most recent of them, whether paid or denied.
